editorial:
You follow a family that moves into a new house, but the real trouble starts when their young son slips into a strange coma-like sleep. Instead of a normal ghost story, the scares come from something darker and closer to home. The parents feel helpless, and the movie keeps you on edge with creepy sounds, sudden jumps, and a growing sense that the danger is not just in the walls.

The acting feels real, especially the parents, and the pacing moves fast without wasting time. The scares are strong, though some moments may feel familiar if you watch a lot of horror. Still, the story has a fun twist that makes it stand out. If you like spooky movies with a creepy atmosphere, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Josh enters the spirit world to bring Dalton home. He finds his son and gets him back, but the old woman who followed Josh since childhood comes back with him into his body. After everyone thinks they are safe, Josh kills Elise, and Renai realizes the man in her house is not really her husband. The movie ends with the possessed Josh standing behind her, leaving the family in danger.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spooky house stories with big scares.
